story.title: Our Story
story.content: SAVINA International Investment Joint Stock Company operates in human resource development for the Japanese market, distance university education, and high-tech agricultural applications. Savina is proud to be a leading training and labor supply enterprise in Vietnam, with experienced instructors and modern facilities. We are committed to the comprehensive development of workers through specialized programs in knowledge, soft skills, and professional conduct.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: Bringing high-quality career development and learning opportunities to Vietnamese people, especially workers abroad, through professional training and direct enterprise connections.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.content: To become Vietnam's leading enterprise in international human resource development, distance education, and technology applications in education and agriculture.
